doc: Under the Autonomous preset a Say proposal within the manager's cells starts with no job/approve; its planning is then done. A say/revise after that is refused with the job's id (a started job is not a proposal to replace, and a revision never cancels running work), the planning agent gets no second prompt, and the one say has one job. Pattern B: a virtual clock; each check reads after the answer that follows the fact it checks (the refusal is the method's own answer, so nothing is sent after it).

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init

sql: select count(*) from job where id = '$job' and status <> 'proposed'

error.message: $job has started: stop it, then say it again
